text:
I manage a hospital ward and need a nurse roster for the next 21 days, numbered day 1 to day 21.
We print the roster and pin it up in the staff room.

There are three shifts every day: early (7:00-15:00), late (15:00-23:00) and night (23:00 until 7:00 the next morning). The night shift of a day is the one that starts at 23:00 on that day.

Nurses (20): Theo, Omar, Sami, Leo, Nikhil, Ben, Maya, Jonas, Bea, Sofia, Viktor, Kemi, Ines, Marco, Hana, Zane, Chloe, Amir, Fiona and Priya. Of these, Theo, Leo, Nikhil, Ben, Jonas, Bea, Kemi and Ines are senior nurses.

Number of nurses needed on each shift (exactly this many, no more and no fewer):
- Day 1: 5 early, 5 late, 1 night.
- Day 2: 5 early, 5 late, 2 night.
- Day 3: 5 early, 6 late, 2 night.
- Day 4: 5 early, 4 late, 3 night.
- Day 5: 4 early, 5 late, 2 night.
- Day 6: 6 early, 6 late, 1 night.
- Day 7: 5 early, 5 late, 3 night.
- Day 8: 5 early, 6 late, 1 night.
- Day 9: 5 early, 4 late, 2 night.
- Day 10: 6 early, 6 late, 1 night.
- Day 11: 6 early, 5 late, 2 night.
- Day 12: 5 early, 4 late, 3 night.
- Day 13: 5 early, 5 late, 1 night.
- Day 14: 5 early, 5 late, 3 night.
- Day 15: 6 early, 5 late, 1 night.
- Day 16: 5 early, 5 late, 1 night.
- Day 17: 5 early, 5 late, 2 night.
- Day 18: 4 early, 5 late, 2 night.
- Day 19: 5 early, 5 late, 3 night.
- Day 20: 5 early, 5 late, 1 night.
- Day 21: 4 early, 5 late, 3 night.

Rules:
- A nurse works at most one shift per day.
- A nurse who works the night shift on one day cannot work the early or the late shift on the next day. (Working the night shift again on the next day is allowed.)
- A nurse who works the late shift on one day cannot work the early shift on the next day.
- No nurse may work on more than 4 days in a row (any shift counts as working that day).
- Every nurse works at least 12 and at most 13 shifts in total over the 21 days.
- No nurse works more than 5 night shifts in total.
- Every night shift must include at least one senior nurse.
- Theo cannot work on day 1.
- Leo cannot work on days 9 and 19.
- Ben cannot work on days 2 and 6.
- Jonas cannot work on day 2.
- Bea cannot work on days 2 and 4.
- Viktor cannot work on day 20.
- Marco cannot work on days 9, 13 and 20.
- Hana cannot work on day 17.
- Zane cannot work on days 1, 5 and 9.
- Chloe cannot work on days 15 and 18.
- Amir cannot work on day 5.
- Fiona cannot work on day 19.
- Omar does not work night shifts.
- Sofia does not work night shifts.
- Fiona does not work night shifts.
- Nothing before day 1 or after day 21 matters: for example, anyone may work the early shift on day 1.

The handover at the start of each shift is part of that shift.

Please find a roster that follows all of these rules: for every nurse and every day, say whether they are off or which shift they work.
answer_keys: shift:<nurse>:<day> for every nurse and every day from 1 to 21: 0 if the nurse is off, 1 for the early shift, 2 for the late shift, 3 for the night shift
